purpose: Current aggregate revision for one Event Agenda, providing an explicit CAS boundary without assigning identity to individual Agenda values.

columns.name: event_ref
columns.meaning: Event whose Agenda aggregate has accepted at least one post-create replacement.
columns.value_contract: Existing Event expectation NativeRef; absence means initial Agenda revision 0.

columns.name: revision
columns.value_contract: Positive monotonic integer; initial create state is represented as implicit revision 0 until the first replacement.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.meaning: Authoritative instant at which this aggregate revision became current.
columns.value_contract: statement_timestamp recorded by the bounded Agenda replacement capability.

primary_key.name: pk_event_agenda_current
primary_key.reason: Exactly one explicit current Agenda revision row may exist per Event.

foreign_keys.name: fk_event_agenda_current_event_ref_event_expectation
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Agenda revision control belongs to the existing Event rather than creating another owner identity.

check_constraints.name: ck_event_agenda_current_revision
check_constraints.reason: Explicit rows exist only after a successful replacement beyond implicit initial revision 0.

indexes.name: pk_event_agenda_current
indexes.reason: Direct current Agenda revision lookup by Event NativeRef.

state_history.current_binding: This row is only aggregate concurrency control. It is not Event MaterialState and does not replace Schedule current/history semantics.
state_history.chronology: revision is a CAS sequence, while updated_at is the authoritative mutation instant.
state_history.immutability_policy: Only the bounded Agenda replacement capability may advance revision; runtime has SELECT only.

lifecycle.retention: Retained after the first accepted Agenda replacement even when the current Agenda becomes empty.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No generic runtime DELETE; B03-D downgrade refuses while current Agenda revision rows exist.

obligations: initial Agenda revision is truthfully 0 without a fabricated row
each accepted replacement advances revision exactly once
stale expected revision conflicts fail closed
